instruction: I am an NLP researcher compiling conference history. Look up ACL best paper awards from 2019 to 2022 on the ACL Anthology website and add all entries to the table best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop. For each award, record the title, year, complete author list (comma-separated), and ACL Anthology PDF link.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 7: Task asks to add all ACL best paper awards from 2019-2022 (4 awards total). Evaluator extracts all data rows and provides partial credit: (1) 50% if at least some rows present but less than 4, (2) For each row, 70% credit for having all 4 columns filled, (3) 30% credit for year being in range 2019-2022. Final score averages across all rows found.

scoring_breakdown.per_row: 70% for all columns filled + 30% for year in range
scoring_breakdown.overall: Average across all rows, with 50% penalty if fewer than min_rows

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts multi-row data from Excel file starting at row 2
Metric correctly checks all requirements: minimum 4 rows, 4 required columns (A, B, C, D), and year range (2019-2022)
Expected parameter handling is correct - directly accesses keys from expected dict without incorrect 'type' or 'rules' access
Postconfig is present and appropriate - activates LibreOffice window and saves file before verification
Partial credit logic is reasonable: 50% penalty for fewer than min_rows, per-row scoring for column completeness (70%) and year validation (30%)

Minor limitation: Evaluator only verifies structural requirements (columns filled, year in range) but cannot verify semantic correctness of content (whether titles/authors/links are actually correct ACL awards). This is inherent to the verification approach for web research tasks.
Edge case handling: Getter skips empty rows, metric handles missing/None values and conversion errors gracefully
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding validation for PDF link format (e.g., should contain 'aclanthology.org') to at least verify domain correctness
Consider checking if year column (B) contains numeric values before type conversion to improve robustness
